# YXZ Landscaping

> Professional interlock repair, power washing, polymeric sanding, and sealing across the Greater Toronto Area.

YXZ Landscaping is a GTA-based hardscaping company specializing in interlock restoration: pressure washing, polymeric sand replacement, sealing (1 or 2 coats), repair, and new installation. Free quotes within 24 hours.

- [Home](/): Overview of services, service area, and customer testimonials.
- [Services & Pricing](/services): Transparent per-square-foot pricing for power washing, sanding, sealing, repair, and installation.
